summary: Frontend-only regression testing completed for new Welcome page and loading system. Tested all major flows including welcome page elements, legal navigation, signup/login, boot splash, loading states, bottom nav transitions, and partial onboarding regression. Backend was skipped as it passed 47/47 tests in iteration_7.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout confirmation dialog button is blocked by modal overlay - click action times out
ui_bugs.workaround: Use force=True in Playwright click or adjust z-index/pointer-events on dialog overlay

ui_bugs.issue: Legal pages (Terms/Privacy) back button does not have data-testid='auth-back-button' - uses different implementation
ui_bugs.note: Back button works functionally, just missing expected testid
Page loads and works, just missing testid for testing

integration_issues.issue: Dev code card not appearing for test phone number +19990000099 during onboarding
integration_issues.note: Test phone numbers with +1999 prefix should show dev_code in response, but card not rendering. May be phone format issue or backend not recognizing test prefix.

passed_tests: Welcome page renders with all elements: logo, wordmark, headline 'Connect with people.', blurb, Create account button, Login button, Terms link, Privacy link
Legal pages (Terms/Privacy) navigation works - pages load and render correctly
Signup flow works - navigates to /signup, form accepts input, button shows spinner during request (aria-busy=true)
Login with neo1788974536@example.com works - lands on /discover
Boot splash appears with valid token - app loads directly to /discover without flash of /welcome
Likes page loads with 3 tabs (All, Likes you, You liked) - all tabs switch correctly
Explore grid loads and displays profile tiles
Bottom nav works perfectly - all 5 tabs (Discover, Explore, Likes, Chat, Profile) navigate correctly with AnimatePresence transitions
Profile page loads with stats and menu rows
Edit Profile page loads with photo grid
Settings page loads with all menu rows
Route transitions work - tabs cross-fade, pushed screens (chat room, edit profile) slide in from right
UserPhoto fade-in works - images get vo-img-ready class after load
Onboarding flow works through name/dob/gender/phone steps - country picker select_option('+1') works
No console errors on any page (only CDN RUM requests fail, which is expected)
action_item_for_main_agent: 1. Fix logout dialog overlay issue - modal overlay blocks button click (add force=True or fix z-index). 2. Investigate why dev code card not showing for test phone +19990000099 in onboarding OTP step. 3. Add missing data-testids: auth-back-button on legal pages, filters-page on filters page. 4. Minor: Discover card not found during testing (user may be out of profiles - not a bug, just test data issue).
